text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
All right! First shrine of the year! Let's go
pray and
get hyped for this year! Things
are gonna be liiit!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I sure have! My bestie squad has been a
big help
with that.
choice_data_list: だいぶ慣れてきたな、パリピ語
だいぶ慣れてきたね、パリピ語
choice_data_list_en: You've gotten pretty used to party animal slang.
You've gotten pretty used to party animal slang.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
And check it out! I'm in my senior year
now! It's
about time we go get the
crowds hyped in the
biggest events!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We've accumulated a good number of
wins, and
we were able to watch Oguri
Cap in action at the
end of last year...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer has experienced a lot, and
I'm sure
she'll be able to put all she's
learned into good
use this year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: By the way, it just occurred to me, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Do you think it'd be better for us to pray
to party
gods instead of regular gods?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I mean, there are plenty of
Umamusume
down here on Earth who are
practically party
gods themselves.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Whaddya think? Should we give it a try?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I suppose she has a point. Modern
problems may
require modern
solutions... like praying to party
gods.
choice_data_list: なるほど、面白いかもな
なるほど、面白いかもね
choice_data_list_en: I see, that could be interesting.
I see, that might be fun.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's head out to meet our new
patrons!
But hold up. There are tons of
different party
gods, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
There are some who know exactly how
to live it
up, and others who've got
looksmaxxing down
pat... Who do you
think we should pray to?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Among the wide array of party gods we
choose
from, I think the one Mejiro
Palmer should pray to
as she's coming
into her own is...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Helios's goddess? ...Oh wait, you mean that Uma she's basically got a crush on? Helios does worship the ground at her feet.
choice_data_list: ダイタクヘリオスの女神

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Like, Helios was literally just crying
about how her
bae left her on read.
What was her name again?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Divine Rubert? Something like that?
Welp, I can't
remember it, but I guess I'll
go pray to her and
see how things go.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Divine" certainly has a goddessy ring to
it, but
Rubert?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hey, there she is! That's gotta be her,
right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Omigosh, there's no way her name is Rubert! She's too cute! She looks just like a doll!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Let's go say hi.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Nuh-uh, no way! Her cuteness is so off
the charts,
I've got super cold feet now.
I'm good just
admiring her from afar.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wow... She's, like, perfect. Just looking
at her is
soothing my spirit...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two of us offer up prayers from a
distance.
Doing so actually makes us feel
like our hearts
and minds are blessed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: The mother of partyers? Hm, I guess we party gals have been around for ages.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
But, if we're talkin' about the mother of
all party
lovers...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hiya, Palmer! Come on, let's cut a rug! ♪
Cha,
cha, cha! Wahoo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, the mother of all partyers is

Maruzensky, a high-energy Umamusume
with a
love for all things retro.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
So, what's popping? You wanna ask me

something?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen, could you teach me first-gen
slang from
the golden days?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
First-gen slang from the golden days?
Well,
there's superfly, neat, and grody!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Talk to the hand, wicked, and
cowabunga! Oh,
and totally tubular!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, none made any sense to me, but
the hype
is real! So this is where it all
began...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I think that worked! I feel totally
stoked!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We take in Maruzensky's bubbly
expression, and
Mejiro Palmer seems a
bit stronger for it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
The goddess of billiards... Huh, yeah, I
guess
there'd be suave and sharp
goddesses, even
among the party gods.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
'Kay, let's go check out some pool
tables and see
who we can find.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
So you're the one who wants pointers on
how to
play billiards, Palmer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah. Wow, the party vibes here are
totes
different to what I'm used to...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Billiards is all about strategy. You let
your
opponents hit the balls however
they like, and
catch 'em off guard out in
the end.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
But that's not my style. I like to get up in
their
face and never let 'em take a shot.
You're the
same, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hold up, how'd we get here? Are you
just gonna
keep steamrolling me like this
ooor...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Under the party god (?) and living
billiard legend
Sirius Symboli's tutelage,
Mejiro Palmer learns
how to be an
aggressive billiards player.
